messages:
sarah_sales: Heads-up: AcmeBank wants a short POC to prove we can replace VendorX without product changes. Primary asks: identical streaming interface, JSON field parity (they consume choices[].message.*), cost comparison at 200M tokens, and a security packet for their procurement. Can we list blockers and owners?

devon_se: What exact VendorX endpoints are they calling? full chat with tool-calls and streaming? embeddings for semantic search? rerank?

sarah_sales: They use chat streaming (+function calls) and embeddings. Their app expects `choices[i].message.role` and `choices[i].message.content` and a top-level `conversation_id`.

oliver_engineer: Tech note: Redwood streams as chunked SSE with `data: {"delta": ...}`. VendorX streams smaller `partial_choice` blobs. We can build a compatibility shim in the SE layer to: (A) reframe SSE into VendorX-like chunks, (B) inject `conversation_id` based on request-id or session token, (C) ensure function-call frames map to their schema. I have a toy shim ready.

anya_security: From the security questionnaire: they flagged (1) EU-only data residency, (2) customer-managed key support (KMS/HSM), (3) retention of full prompt text in logs, and (4) evidence of SOC2 + recent external pentest. We'll need certs + a short answer doc.

mike_infra: Ops: We can provision an EU-dedicated Dedicated cluster in ~5 business days (assuming contract). Private deployment supports customer KMS and HSM; Hosted can do TPM-backed key wrapping or isolated key segments for enterprise. Logs can be disabled or redacted for PII on request.

sarah_sales: Pricing: VendorX quoted ~$14k/mo for ~200M tokens. Acme asks for a comparable monthly cost to present in presales. Need a defensible estimate to put in the SOW.

devon_se: Presales estimate (conservative): infra amortized + GPU + networking w/ batching and 8-bit quantization => ~$6k-8k/mo. Redwood service and support/observability add ~$2k. Recommend quoting $9.5k/mo as a presales anchor with note: +/- 20% depending on token length and streaming behavior.

oliver_engineer: For behavioral parity testing I propose: pick 500 canonical prompts (mix short/long, function-call, multilingual), run VendorX + Redwood+shim, normalize JSON keys, and compute: token delta, exact-field diffs, BLEU, and embedding cosine. I'll assemble a harness and post results. Example run: `./tools/compat_run.sh --prompts testsets/acme-500.json --vendor vendorx --target redwood://poc-acme-eu`

mike_infra: Small gotcha: VendorX includes `detected_language` in responses which Acme uses to route downstream. Our shim can call our langdetect microservice at ingest and attach `detected_language` (adds ~15ms median latency). We'll document this in the appendix.

sarah_sales: Legal/procurement wants the security packet (SOC2, pen-test summary, architecture diagram) and a short description of the shim for their engineers. Can we package that by EOD Wed?

anya_security: I can compile SOC2 cert + redacted pentest + vuln disclosure policy. Need the Acme security contact to share sensitive docs. Also confirm whether they'll accept Hosted with key-wrapping or require Private.

rdw-ci-bot: POC env provisioned: redwood-poc-acme-eu (dev). SEs added to the project. Credentials shared via Vault. :white_check_mark:

devon_se: Suggested immediate next steps: 1) Oliver: drop compat-shim repo + README w/ simple example (2 business days). 2) Infra: stand up EU POC cluster (5 business days). 3) Security: assemble packet + contract language on logs/KMS (2 business days). 4) Sales: send a provisional SOW with $9.5k/mo anchor. Kickoff meeting Tue 09:30 UTC?

sarah_sales: Tue 09:30 UTC works. I'll loop in Acme eng + legal and send calendar invite.

oliver_engineer: I'll post the shim repo link when ready. Quick shim example (pseudo):

```
# receive our sse stream
for sse in stream:
  payload = json.loads(sse.data)
  # map to VendorX partial_choice
  out = {"partial_choice": {"message": payload['delta'], "conversation_id": session_id}}
  send_chunk(out)
```

mike_infra: I'll prepare a one-pager listing API differences (stream framing, conversation_id, function-call arg shape, detected_language) and mitigation recommendations for their client engineers.

sarah_sales: Great — thanks all. Blockers status: data residency & KMS (infra ok), parity testing (oliver/devon), pricing (devon anchor), security packet (anya). Anything else? :eyes:

anya_security: Please DM Acme security contact for secure share of pentest. Add hannah.lee@acmebank.com to the invite.

sarah_sales: Added hannah.lee@acmebank.com. Sending invite now. :thumbsup:
